notes: v023 is selected to the base; the ASV's marginal to turn them construes the same reading differently and is not a textual gap.
The repeated from at t014 is carried by the article τῆς rather than marked added, one Greek ἀπό governing two coordinate members and the ASV writing a determiner for the second (rules 21, 103).
τῇ before εἰς ἐμέ is left unrepresented because the ASV supplies no relative clause for that verbless modifier (rules 23, 31), and both articular-infinitive articles are empty under rule 61.
